queries.name: above_top_solid
queries.summary: Height just above the topmost solid block at a world x/z column
queries.description: Gives the Y coordinate of the first position above the highest solid block in the column at the world `x`, `z` you pass in. Useful for placing features on the surface during world generation.

args.name: x
args.description: World X coordinate of the column

args.name: z
args.description: World Z coordinate of the column

notes: World generation only: outside world-gen Molang the query does not resolve.
The published argument range is open-ended; pass exactly an x and a z.

queries.name: actor_count
queries.summary: Number of entities drawn in the previous frame
queries.description: Returns how many entities the client rendered during the last frame. Handy for scaling back expensive effects when a scene is busy.
notes: Client-only: use it in resource packs; it has no meaning in behavior packs.

queries.name: all
queries.summary: 1 if every remaining argument equals the first one, else 0
queries.description: Compares the first argument against every argument after it. The result is `1.0` when each of those matches the first value exactly, and `0.0` as soon as one differs.

args.name: candidate
args.description: Values that must all equal `value` (two or more)

notes: Needs at least three arguments (the value plus two or more to compare); fewer logs a content error.

queries.name: all_animations_finished
queries.summary: 1 once every animation in the current controller state has played through
queries.description: Inside an animation controller, yields `1.0` once every animation in the active state has reached its end at least one time, and `0.0` before that. Typically used in a transition to leave a one-shot state.
notes: Only meaningful inside an animation controller (for example in a state's transitions).

queries.name: all_tags
queries.summary: 1 if the item or block has every one of the given tags
queries.description: Checks the item or block being matched against the tag names you pass and returns `1.0` if it carries all of them, otherwise `0.0`.
notes: Only available in tag expressions of item and block descriptors (e.g. the `tags` field of a recipe ingredient or a block filter). Entity, block-permutation and world-gen Molang do not know this query.
Every argument must be a string tag name; at least one is required.

queries.name: anger_level
queries.summary: Current anger level of the entity (server side)
queries.description: Returns the entity's anger level as a number from 0 upward (as used by the warden). Returns `0` when the entity has no anger tracking or the value cannot be read.
notes: Server-side only: it works in behavior pack Molang and logs an error when evaluated on the client (resource packs, render controllers, client animations).

queries.name: anim_time
queries.summary: Seconds since the current animation started
queries.description: Elapsed playback time, in seconds, of the animation this expression belongs to. Outside of an animation there is no clock to read, so the result is `0.0`.
notes: Only has a real value inside an animation; elsewhere it is always 0.

queries.name: any
queries.summary: 1 if any remaining argument equals the first one, else 0
queries.description: Compares the first argument against every argument after it and yields `1.0` if at least one of them matches the first value, `0.0` if none do. A compact way to test a value against a list of options.

args.name: candidate
args.description: Values to compare with (two or more)

notes: Needs at least three arguments (the value plus two or more candidates); with only one candidate use `==` instead.

queries.name: any_animation_finished
queries.summary: 1 once any animation in the current controller state has played through
queries.description: Inside an animation controller, yields `1.0` as soon as one animation in the active state has reached its end at least one time, and `0.0` before that.
notes: Only meaningful inside an animation controller (for example in a state's transitions).

queries.name: any_tag
queries.summary: 1 if the item or block has at least one of the given tags
queries.description: Checks the item or block being matched against the tag names you pass and returns `1.0` if it carries any of them, otherwise `0.0`.
notes: Only available in tag expressions of item and block descriptors (e.g. the `tags` field of a recipe ingredient or a block filter). Entity, block-permutation and world-gen Molang do not know this query.
Every argument must be a string tag name; at least one is required.

queries.name: approx_eq
queries.summary: 1 if all arguments are nearly equal (within a small tolerance)
queries.description: Returns `1.0` when every argument lies within a very small tolerance of the others, otherwise `0.0`. Use it instead of `==` when comparing floating-point results.
notes: Requires at least two arguments.
The tolerance is very small, meant to absorb floating-point rounding rather than to compare loosely.

queries.name: armor_color_slot
queries.summary: One color channel of the dyed armor in an armor slot
queries.description: Returns a single color channel of the armor worn in the given slot, such as dyed leather armor. Pass the armor slot index (0 head, 1 chest, 2 legs, 3 feet, 4 body) and the channel (0 red, 1 green, 2 blue, 3 alpha).

args.name: channel
args.description: Color channel: 0 R, 1 G, 2 B, 3 A

notes: Needs an entity; it cannot be used in a world particle or block context.

queries.name: armor_damage_slot
queries.summary: Damage value of the armor piece in an armor slot
queries.description: Returns the damage (durability used) of the armor worn in the given slot. Slot indices: 0 head, 1 chest, 2 legs, 3 feet, 4 body.
notes: Needs an entity; it cannot be used in a world particle or block context.

queries.name: armor_material_slot
queries.summary: Armor material type in a humanoid armor slot
queries.description: Returns a number identifying the material of the armor worn in the given slot. Only the four humanoid slots are valid: 0 head, 1 chest, 2 legs, 3 feet.
notes: Unlike the other armor slot queries, slot 4 (body) is not accepted here.
Needs an entity; it cannot be used in a world particle or block context.

queries.name: armor_texture_slot
queries.summary: Texture type of the armor in an armor slot
queries.description: Returns a number identifying the texture type of the armor worn in the given slot. Slot indices: 0 head, 1 chest, 2 legs, 3 feet, 4 body.
notes: Needs an entity; it cannot be used in a world particle or block context.

queries.name: average_frame_time
queries.summary: Average frame time in seconds over recent frames
queries.description: Returns the frame time in seconds. With no argument (or `0`) it is the duration of the previous frame; with `n` it averages the last `n + 1` frames. Only a limited history is kept, so large values are capped to what is stored.

args.name: frames
args.description: How many extra past frames to average in

notes: Client-only: use it in resource packs; it has no meaning in behavior packs.

queries.name: base_swing_duration
queries.summary: Base length of the mob's swing/attack animation
queries.description: Length of the entity's swing or attack animation as set by the item it carries, before any status effects adjust it.
notes: Needs an entity.

queries.name: block_face
queries.summary: Face of the block involved in the current placement or interaction
queries.description: Returns which face of the block the triggering event refers to: 0 down, 1 up, 2 north, 3 south, 4 west, 5 east, 6 undefined. Only filled in by certain triggers, such as block placement or block interaction.
notes: Outside a trigger that supplies face information it logs a content error.
Replaces the deprecated `query.cardinal_block_face_placed_on`.

queries.name: block_has_all_tags
queries.summary: 1 if the block at a world position has all the given tags
queries.description: Looks up the block at the absolute world position `x`, `y`, `z` and returns `1` if it carries every tag you list, otherwise `0`.
notes: Coordinates are world coordinates, not offsets from the entity or block. For a position relative to the current block use `query.block_neighbor_has_all_tags`.
Tag arguments must be strings; at least one tag is required after the three coordinates.

queries.name: block_has_any_tag
queries.summary: 1 if the block at a world position has any of the given tags
queries.description: Looks up the block at the absolute world position `x`, `y`, `z` and returns `1` if it carries at least one of the tags you list, otherwise `0`.
notes: Coordinates are world coordinates, not offsets from the entity or block. For a position relative to the current block use `query.block_neighbor_has_any_tag`.
Tag arguments must be strings; at least one tag is required after the three coordinates.

queries.name: block_neighbor_has_all_tags
queries.summary: 1 if the block at an offset from this block has all the given tags
queries.description: Looks at the block at offset `x`, `y`, `z` from the current block and returns `1` if it carries every tag you list, otherwise `0`.

args.name: x
args.description: X offset from the current block

args.name: y
args.description: Y offset from the current block

args.name: z
args.description: Z offset from the current block

notes: Only works in block Molang (for example block permutation conditions); entity and particle contexts cannot reach neighbouring blocks.
The published minimum is 1 argument, but three numeric offsets plus at least one string tag are required.

queries.name: block_neighbor_has_any_tag
queries.summary: 1 if the block at an offset from this block has any of the given tags
queries.description: Looks at the block at offset `x`, `y`, `z` from the current block and returns `1` if it carries at least one of the tags you list, otherwise `0`.

args.name: x
args.description: X offset from the current block

args.name: y
args.description: Y offset from the current block

args.name: z
args.description: Z offset from the current block

notes: Only works in block Molang (for example block permutation conditions); entity and particle contexts cannot reach neighbouring blocks.
The published minimum is 1 argument, but three numeric offsets plus at least one string tag are required.

queries.name: block_property
queries.summary: Value of a block property of the current block (legacy)
queries.description: Returns the value of the named property of the block being evaluated. This is the older form of `query.block_state`.
notes: Removed: it fails to resolve in content whose Molang version is 1.20.40 or newer. Use `query.block_state` instead.
Only works on blocks; the name must be a property the block actually declares.
The result has the property's own type (number, boolean as 0/1, or string).

versionGate.meaning: resolvable only while the file's Molang version is below this SemVersion; unknown-query error at/after it

queries.name: block_state
queries.summary: Value of a block state of the current block
queries.description: Returns the current value of the named block state on the block being evaluated. The result has the state's own type: an integer, a boolean (0 or 1), or a string you can compare with `==`.
notes: Only works on blocks. It is the only query allowed in block permutation `condition` and geometry `bone_visibility` expressions.
The state must be declared by the block (in `states` or via a trait); an unknown name logs a content error.

queries.name: blocking
queries.summary: 1 if the entity is currently blocking (e.g. with a shield)
queries.description: Returns `1.0` while the entity is blocking, such as holding up a shield, otherwise `0.0`.
notes: Needs an entity.

queries.name: body_x_rotation
queries.summary: Body pitch of the entity, in degrees
queries.description: Returns the pitch (X rotation) of the entity's body in degrees, or `0.0` when there is no entity.
notes: Needs an entity.

queries.name: body_y_rotation
queries.summary: Body yaw of the entity, in degrees
queries.description: Returns the yaw (Y rotation) of the entity's body in degrees, or `0.0` when there is no entity.
notes: Needs an entity.

queries.name: bone_aabb
queries.summary: Axis-aligned bounding box of a bone, as a struct
queries.description: Returns the axis-aligned bounding box of the named bone as a struct with `.min` and `.max`, each holding `.x`, `.y` and `.z`. Store it in a variable to read the members.

args.name: bone
args.description: Name of the bone in the geometry

notes: Client-only: use it in resource packs.
Returns a struct, not a number, so it cannot be used directly in arithmetic; assign it to a variable first.

queries.name: bone_orientation_matrix
queries.summary: Current orientation of a bone as a matrix
queries.description: Returns the current orientation of the named bone as a matrix. If the bone is not in the entity's queryable geometry, it logs a content error and returns the identity matrix.
notes: Needs an animated entity (client entity or attachable); not available in particles or blocks.
The result is a matrix, not a number, so assign it to a variable rather than using it in arithmetic.
Declared to take up to two arguments, but only the first one, the bone name, is documented.

queries.name: bone_orientation_trs
queries.summary: Bone orientation split into translation, rotation and scale
queries.description: Returns the named bone's current orientation broken into a struct with `.t` (translation), `.r` (rotation) and `.s` (scale), each with `.x`, `.y` and `.z`. If the bone is missing from the queryable geometry, it logs a content error and returns an identity result.
notes: Needs an animated entity (client entity or attachable); not available in particles or blocks.
Returns a struct; assign it to a variable and read its members.
Declared to take up to two arguments, but only the first one, the bone name, is documented.

queries.name: bone_origin
queries.summary: Pivot of a bone as authored in the geometry file
queries.description: Returns the initial pivot of the named bone, as defined in the `.geo.json`, as a struct with `.x`, `.y` and `.z`. Animation does not affect it.

args.name: bone
args.description: Name of the bone in the geometry

notes: Client-only: use it in resource packs.
Returns a struct, not a number; assign it to a variable first.

queries.name: bone_rotation
queries.summary: Rotation of a bone as authored in the geometry file, in degrees
queries.description: Returns the initial rotation of the named bone, as defined in the `.geo.json`, as a struct with `.x`, `.y` and `.z` in degrees. Animation does not affect it.

args.name: bone
args.description: Name of the bone in the geometry

notes: Client-only: use it in resource packs.
Returns a struct, not a number; assign it to a variable first.

queries.name: camera_distance_range_lerp
queries.summary: 0..1 ramp of camera distance between two distances
queries.description: Maps the current camera distance onto `0..1` between the two distances you pass, clamping outside that span. For `(8, 24)` the result is 0 at 8 blocks or nearer, 0.5 at 16 and 1 at 24 or beyond; giving the larger distance first inverts the ramp.
notes: Only meaningful on the client for entities, attachables and particles; blocks and server-side Molang have no camera.

queries.name: camera_rotation
queries.summary: Camera rotation around the X or Y axis
queries.description: Returns the camera's rotation on the axis you choose: `0` for pitch (X), `1` for yaw (Y).
notes: Client-only: use it in resource packs.

queries.name: can_climb
queries.summary: 1 if the entity is able to climb
queries.description: Returns `1.0` if the entity has the ability to climb (for example ladders or vines), otherwise `0.0`.
notes: Needs an entity.

queries.name: can_damage_nearby_mobs
queries.summary: 1 if the entity can damage nearby mobs
queries.description: Returns `1.0` if the entity is able to damage mobs close to it, otherwise `0.0`.
notes: Needs an entity.

queries.name: can_dash
queries.summary: 1 if the entity is able to dash
queries.description: Returns `1.0` if the entity has a dash ability available to it (as the camel does), otherwise `0.0`.
notes: Needs an entity.

queries.name: can_fly
queries.summary: 1 if the entity is able to fly
queries.description: Returns `1.0` if the entity can fly, otherwise `0.0`.
notes: Needs an entity.

queries.name: can_power_jump
queries.summary: 1 if the entity can do a charged (power) jump
queries.description: Returns `1.0` if the entity is able to perform a power jump, like a horse charging its jump, otherwise `0.0`.
notes: Needs an entity.

queries.name: can_swim
queries.summary: 1 if the entity is able to swim
queries.description: Returns `1.0` if the entity can swim, otherwise `0.0`.
notes: Needs an entity.

queries.name: can_walk
queries.summary: 1 if the entity is able to walk
queries.description: Returns `1.0` if the entity can walk, otherwise `0.0`.
notes: Needs an entity.

queries.name: cape_flap_amount
queries.summary: How far the player's cape is lifted, 0 (down) to 1 (up)
queries.description: Returns a value from `0.0` (cape hanging straight down) to `1.0` (cape fully raised), used to animate capes.
notes: Its calculation differs between content with a Molang version below 1.20.0 and content at 1.20.0 or newer, so results can change when you bump the version.
Only meaningful on client entities and attachables; elsewhere it returns a default.

queries.name: cardinal_block_face_placed_on
queries.summary: Deprecated: face the block was placed on; use query.block_face
queries.description: Returns which face the block was placed against (0 down, 1 up, 2 north, 3 south, 4 west, 5 east, 6 undefined). Only filled in by the block-placed-by-player trigger.
notes: Deprecated: use `query.block_face` instead.
Outside a placement trigger it logs a content error.

queries.name: cardinal_facing
queries.summary: Direction the entity is facing, including up and down
queries.description: Returns the direction the entity is looking toward as a face number: 0 down, 1 up, 2 north, 3 south, 4 west, 5 east, 6 undefined.
notes: Needs an entity. To ignore up and down, use `query.cardinal_facing_2d`.

queries.name: cardinal_facing_2d
queries.summary: Horizontal direction the entity is facing (north/south/west/east)
queries.description: Returns the horizontal direction the entity is facing, ignoring the vertical part of its view: 2 north, 3 south, 4 west, 5 east, 6 undefined.
notes: Needs an entity. Never returns 0 (down) or 1 (up).

queries.name: cardinal_player_facing
queries.summary: Direction the player is facing, including up and down
queries.description: Returns the direction a player is looking toward as a face number: 0 down, 1 up, 2 north, 3 south, 4 west, 5 east, 6 undefined.
notes: Only works on players; on any other entity it logs a content error. Use `query.cardinal_facing` for other entities.

queries.name: client_max_render_distance
queries.summary: Maximum render distance of this client, in chunks
queries.description: Returns the largest render distance, in chunks, that the current client supports.
notes: Client-only: use it in resource packs.

queries.name: client_memory_tier
queries.summary: Memory tier of the device, from 0 (super low) to 4 (super high)
queries.description: Returns the device's memory tier: 0 super low, 1 low, 2 mid, 3 high, 4 super high. Useful for lowering detail on weaker devices.
notes: Client-only: use it in resource packs.

queries.name: combine_entities
queries.summary: Merge entity references and arrays into one array
queries.description: Gathers the entity references found in its arguments, whether passed singly or inside arrays, into one array. Invalid references and repeats are dropped, and the resulting order is not guaranteed.

args.name: entities
args.description: An entity or array of entities (one or more)

notes: Do not rely on the order of the result.
The result is an array, not a number; pass it to something like `query.count` or store it in a variable.

queries.name: cooldown_time
queries.summary: Total cooldown, in seconds, of the item in an equipment slot
queries.description: Returns the full cooldown length in seconds of the item held or worn in the named equipment slot, or `0` if there is none. Slot names are the ones `/replaceitem` uses; slots with several positions also take an index.

args.name: index
args.description: Slot index, required for multi-slot containers

notes: Needs an entity.
For slots such as 'slot.hotbar' or 'slot.inventory' the second, numeric index argument is required.

queries.name: cooldown_time_remaining
queries.summary: Seconds left on a cooldown (by category or equipment slot)
queries.description: Returns the remaining cooldown in seconds, either for a named cooldown category or for the item in the named equipment slot, or `0` if nothing is cooling down. With no arguments it returns the longest remaining cooldown on the entity.

args.name: slot_or_category
args.description: Cooldown category name, or equipment slot like 'slot.weapon.mainhand'

args.name: index
args.description: Slot index, required for multi-slot containers

notes: Needs an entity.
The first argument must not be an empty string. Slot names follow `/replaceitem`; multi-slot containers need the numeric index as the second argument.

queries.name: count
queries.summary: Count its arguments, expanding arrays into their elements
queries.description: Returns how many values were passed in. An array counts as the number of elements it holds; any other value counts as 1.

queries.name: current_squish_value
queries.summary: Current squish amount of the entity (e.g. slimes)
queries.description: Returns the entity's current squish value, used for squash-and-stretch on slime-like mobs. Returns `0.0` for entities where squishing does not apply.
notes: Needs an entity.

queries.name: dash_cooldown_progress
queries.summary: Deprecated: camel dash cooldown progress
queries.description: Returned the camel's dash cooldown progress, or `0.0` for entities that cannot dash.
notes: Deprecated, no direct replacement: track the cooldown yourself with variables in the client entity's `scripts.pre_animation`, as the vanilla camel now does.
Fails to resolve in content whose Molang version is 1.20.50 or newer.
Client-side only, and only works on the camel.

versionGate.meaning: resolvable only while the file's Molang version is below this SemVersion; unknown-query error at/after it

queries.name: day
queries.summary: Current day number of the world
queries.description: Returns the number of the current in-game day of the world.
notes: Evaluated through an entity, so it is not available in world particles or blocks.

queries.name: death_ticks
queries.summary: Ticks elapsed since the mob started dying
queries.description: Returns how many ticks have passed since the mob began dying, for driving death animations.
notes: Needs an entity. Measured in ticks (20 per second), not seconds.

queries.name: debug_output
queries.summary: Write a value to the debug output window, where one exists
queries.description: Logs the given value to the debug output window in builds of the game that have one. In regular retail builds it has no visible effect.
notes: Intended for development builds; do not rely on it for anything in a shipped pack.

queries.name: delta_time
queries.summary: Seconds elapsed since the previous frame
queries.description: Returns the time in seconds between the previous frame and this one. Multiply per-second rates by it for frame-rate independent animation.
notes: Only has a real value on client entities and attachables; elsewhere it returns a default (0).

queries.name: distance_from_camera
queries.summary: Distance from the camera to this entity or emitter, in blocks
queries.description: Returns the distance in blocks between the camera and the root of the current entity or particle emitter.
notes: Only meaningful on the client for entities, attachables and particles; blocks and server-side Molang have no camera.

queries.name: effect_emitter_count
queries.summary: Number of active emitters of this particle effect type
queries.description: Returns how many emitters of the current particle effect type are active right now. Useful for capping an effect when many copies exist.
notes: Client-only; intended for particle effects.

queries.name: effect_particle_count
queries.summary: Number of active particles of this particle effect type
queries.description: Returns how many particles of the current particle effect type are alive right now, across all its emitters.
notes: Client-only; intended for particle effects.

queries.name: entity_biome_has_all_tags
queries.summary: 1 if the biome the entity stands in has all the given tags
queries.description: Checks the biome at the entity's position and returns `1` if it has every biome tag you list, otherwise `0`.
notes: Resource packs only: evaluated on the server (behavior packs) it logs an error.
Needs an entity; every argument must be a string tag and at least one is required.

queries.name: entity_biome_has_any_identifier
queries.summary: 1 if the entity's current biome matches any of the given ids
queries.description: Checks the biome at the entity's position and returns `1` if its identifier is one of those you list, otherwise `0`.
notes: Resource packs only: evaluated on the server (behavior packs) it logs an error.
Identifiers must include the namespace, e.g. 'minecraft:plains'; at least one is required.

queries.name: entity_biome_has_any_tags
queries.summary: 1 if the biome the entity stands in has any of the given tags
queries.description: Checks the biome at the entity's position and returns `1` if it has at least one of the biome tags you list, otherwise `0`.
notes: Resource packs only: evaluated on the server (behavior packs) it logs an error.
Needs an entity; every argument must be a string tag and at least one is required.

queries.name: equipment_count
queries.summary: Number of armor pieces the entity is wearing
queries.description: Returns how many armor slots of the entity currently hold an item, from 0 up to 5. Items held in the main hand or off hand are not counted.
notes: To check what is held in the hands, see `query.is_item_equipped` and `query.is_item_name_any`.

queries.name: equipped_item_all_tags
queries.summary: Whether the item in a slot has every one of the given tags
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the item in the given equipment slot carries **all** of the listed item tags, otherwise 0.0. The first argument is the slot name, the rest are tag names.

args.name: tag
args.description: Item tag to require; repeat for more tags

notes: Needs at least two arguments: a slot name followed by one or more tags. With fewer, it logs a content error.
Tags are passed as quoted strings, e.g. 'minecraft:is_tool'.
An unknown slot name logs an error.

queries.name: equipped_item_any_tag
queries.summary: Whether the item in a slot has at least one of the given tags
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the item in the given equipment slot carries **at least one** of the listed item tags, otherwise 0.0. The first argument is the slot name, the rest are tag names.

args.name: tag
args.description: Item tag to look for; repeat for more tags

notes: Needs at least two arguments: a slot name followed by one or more tags. With fewer, it logs a content error.
Tags are passed as quoted strings, e.g. 'minecraft:is_sword'.
An unknown slot name logs an error.

queries.name: equipped_item_is_attachable
queries.summary: Whether the item held in a hand has an attachable definition
queries.description: Tells you whether the item in the chosen hand is rendered through an attachable. Pass 0 or 'main_hand' for the main hand, 1 or 'off_hand' for the off hand.
notes: Resource packs only: on the server side (behavior packs) it does not return a meaningful value.
The game declares this query with an unusual, non-numeric result type, so using it as an operand, for example `q.equipped_item_is_attachable(0) * 2`, may be rejected when the file loads.

queries.name: eye_target_x_rotation
queries.summary: Vertical (pitch) rotation of the entity's eyes toward its look target
queries.description: Returns the X (pitch) rotation the entity's eyes should use to look at its target. Returns 0.0 for entities where this does not apply.
notes: Registered as accepting any number of arguments, but none are used.

queries.name: eye_target_y_rotation
queries.summary: Horizontal (yaw) rotation of the entity's eyes toward its look target
queries.description: Returns the Y (yaw) rotation the entity's eyes should use to look at its target. Returns 0.0 for entities where this does not apply.
notes: Registered as accepting any number of arguments, but none are used.

queries.name: facing_target_to_range_attack
queries.summary: Whether the entity is facing its target for a ranged attack
queries.description: Returns 1.0 while the entity is performing a ranged attack against its target (as driven by the `minecraft:behavior.ranged_attack` goal), otherwise 0.0.

queries.name: frame_alpha
queries.summary: How far the current frame is between two game ticks (0..1)
queries.description: Returns a value from 0 to 1 describing where the frame being rendered falls between the previous and the next game tick. Useful for smoothing values that only update once per tick.
notes: Only meaningful while an entity or attachable is being rendered; elsewhere it returns a fixed default.

queries.name: fuse_time
queries.summary: Remaining fuse time of an exploding entity
queries.description: Gives the time left before the entity's fuse runs out and it explodes. Entities without a `minecraft:explode` component report -1.

queries.name: get_actor_info_id
queries.summary: Numeric id of an entity type, looked up by its identifier
queries.description: Takes an entity identifier string and returns the internal integer id the game uses for that entity type.
notes: The numeric ids are internal and can change between game versions; avoid hard-coding them.

queries.name: get_animation_frame
queries.summary: Current animation frame of the item being rendered
queries.description: Returns the current frame of the item's animated texture, for an item that is held or owned by an entity.
notes: Only works for an item that has an owning entity; otherwise it logs a content error.

queries.name: get_default_bone_pivot
queries.summary: One axis of a bone's default pivot point
queries.description: Returns the x, y or z component of the named bone's pivot as defined in the model, before any animation is applied.
notes: Resource packs only: on the server side (behavior packs) it does not return a meaningful value.
Both arguments are required: the bone name, then the axis. The axis may be given as 0, 1, 2 or as 'x', 'y', 'z'.
The entity must have an animation component (a client entity with geometry); otherwise it logs an error.

queries.name: get_equipped_item_name
queries.summary: Name of the item in a hand slot (deprecated)
queries.description: Returns the name of the item in the requested hand, or an empty string when the hand is empty. Defaults to the main hand when no argument is given.

args.name: rendered
args.description: 0 for the equipped item, non-zero for the item currently being rendered

notes: Deprecated: prefer `query.is_item_name_any`, which tests the item against a list of names instead of returning one.
The result is a string: compare it with `==` or `!=`; it cannot be used in arithmetic.

queries.name: get_level_seed_based_fraction
queries.summary: A stable 0..1 value derived from the world seed
queries.description: Returns a number between 0.0 and 1.0 computed from the world's seed. It stays the same for a given world, so you can use it to vary visuals between worlds.
notes: Needs an entity in a loaded level; elsewhere it logs an error.

queries.name: get_locator_offset
queries.summary: One axis of a locator's offset in the entity's model
queries.description: Returns the x, y or z component of the named locator's offset in the entity's current geometry.
notes: Both arguments are required: the locator name, then the axis (0, 1, 2 or 'x', 'y', 'z').
Needs an entity with an animation component (geometry); logs an error if the locator cannot be found.

queries.name: get_name
queries.summary: Name tag of the entity (deprecated)
queries.description: Returns the entity's custom name, or an empty string when it has none.
notes: Deprecated: prefer `query.is_name_any`, which tests the name against a list instead of returning it.
The result is a string: compare it with `==` or `!=`; it cannot be used in arithmetic.

queries.name: get_pack_setting
queries.summary: Current value of a pack setting slider
queries.description: Returns the value the player chose for the named slider in the resource pack's settings.
notes: Resource packs only: behavior packs cannot use pack setting queries.
The name must be a quoted string matching a setting declared by the pack; otherwise an error is logged.
Needs an entity or level context.

queries.name: get_root_locator_offset
queries.summary: One axis of a locator's offset in the root model
queries.description: Like `query.get_locator_offset`, but reads the locator from the root model (for example the entity that holds or wears an attachable) rather than the current one.

args.name: locator
args.description: Locator name from the root geometry

notes: Both arguments are required: the locator name, then the axis (0, 1, 2 or 'x', 'y', 'z').
Needs a root animation component; logs an error when there is none or the locator is missing.

queries.name: graphics_mode_is_any
queries.summary: Whether the client's graphics mode matches any of the given names
queries.description: Checks the client's current graphics mode against the names you pass and gives 1.0 on a match, 0.0 otherwise. The recognised names are 'simple', 'fancy', 'deferred' and 'raytraced'.
notes: Resource packs only: on the server side (behavior packs) it does not return a meaningful value.

queries.name: ground_speed
queries.summary: Horizontal speed of the entity, in blocks per second
queries.description: Returns how fast the entity is moving along the ground, in blocks (meters) per second. Vertical movement is not included.

queries.name: had_component_group
queries.summary: Whether saved entity data had a given component group
queries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is being loaded from save data in which the named component group was active, otherwise 0.0. It lets an entity property take its initial value from an older version of the entity definition.
notes: Only usable in the `default` field of an entity property in a behavior pack.
Takes exactly one string argument.

queries.name: has_all_biome_tags
queries.summary: Whether the biome at the placement position has all the given tags
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the biome at the current feature placement position carries **every** listed biome tag, otherwise 0.0.

args.name: tag
args.description: Biome tag; repeat for more tags

notes: World generation only: available in feature and feature-rule expressions, not in entity or resource pack Molang.

queries.name: has_any_biome_tags
queries.summary: Whether the biome at the placement position has any of the given tags
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the biome at the current feature placement position carries **at least one** of the listed biome tags, otherwise 0.0.

args.name: tag
args.description: Biome tag; repeat for more tags

notes: World generation only: available in feature and feature-rule expressions, not in entity or resource pack Molang.

queries.name: has_any_family
queries.summary: Whether the entity belongs to any of the given families
queries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity's type family list contains at least one of the given family names, otherwise 0.0.

args.name: family
args.description: Family name, e.g. 'monster'; repeat for more

notes: Needs at least one argument, and every argument must be a string.

queries.name: has_any_leashed_entity_of_type
queries.summary: Whether the entity is leashing an entity of any given type
queries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity currently holds a leash attached to at least one entity of the listed types, otherwise 0.0.

args.name: identifier
args.description: Entity identifier, e.g. 'minecraft:horse'; repeat for more

notes: Needs at least one argument, and every argument must be a string.

queries.name: has_armor_slot
queries.summary: Whether the entity has armor in a given slot
queries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is wearing something in the given armor slot, otherwise 0.0. Slots are numbered 0 = head, 1 = chest, 2 = legs, 3 = feet.
notes: Takes exactly one number in the range 0..3.
Needs an entity; elsewhere it logs an error.

queries.name: has_biome_tag
queries.summary: Whether the biome at the placement (or given) position has a tag
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the biome has the given tag, otherwise 0.0. With only a tag it checks the current placement position; you can also pass x and z, or x, y and z, to check another position.

args.name: y_or_z
args.description: World Z in the 3-argument form, world Y in the 4-argument form

notes: World generation only: available in feature and feature-rule expressions, not in entity or resource pack Molang.
Accepted forms: (tag), (tag, x, z) and (tag, x, y, z).

queries.name: has_block_property
queries.summary: Whether the block has a given block state (removed)
queries.description: Returns 1.0 if the current block has the named block state, otherwise 0.0.
notes: Superseded by `query.has_block_state`, which does the same check in current files.
Only resolves in files whose Molang version is below 1.20.40; in newer files it is an unknown query.
Only works on blocks.

versionGate.meaning: resolvable only while the file's Molang version is below this SemVersion; unknown-query error at/after it

queries.name: has_block_state
queries.summary: Whether the block has a given block state
queries.description: Returns 1.0 if the current block defines the named block state, otherwise 0.0.
notes: Only works on blocks.
Takes exactly one string argument.

queries.name: has_cape
queries.summary: Whether the player has a cape
queries.description: Returns 1.0 if the player has a cape equipped, otherwise 0.0.

queries.name: has_collision
queries.summary: Whether the entity has collision enabled
queries.description: Returns 1.0 if collisions are enabled for the entity, otherwise 0.0.

queries.name: has_dash_cooldown
queries.summary: Whether the entity's dash is on cooldown
queries.description: Returns 1.0 while the entity's dash ability is cooling down (as used by the camel), otherwise 0.0.

queries.name: has_gravity
queries.summary: Whether the entity is affected by gravity
queries.description: Returns 1.0 if gravity applies to the entity, otherwise 0.0.

queries.name: has_head_gear
queries.summary: Whether the entity has something in its head armor slot
queries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is wearing an item in its head slot, otherwise 0.0. Also returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: has_owner
queries.summary: Whether the entity has an owner
queries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity has an owner (for example a tamed animal), otherwise 0.0.

queries.name: has_player_rider
queries.summary: Whether a player is riding the entity
queries.description: Returns 1.0 if a player occupies any of the entity's seats, otherwise 0.0.

queries.name: has_property
queries.summary: Whether the entity defines a given property
queries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity has a property with the given name, otherwise 0.0.
notes: Takes exactly one string argument.
One of the few queries allowed in the `set_property` event response.

queries.name: has_rider
queries.summary: Whether anything is riding the entity
queries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity has at least one rider, otherwise 0.0.

queries.name: has_target
queries.summary: Whether the entity has a target
queries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity currently has a target (usually the entity it is attacking), otherwise 0.0.

queries.name: head_is_in_water
queries.summary: Whether the entity's head is under water
queries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity's head is in water, otherwise 0.0.

queries.name: head_roll_angle
queries.summary: Roll angle of the entity's head
queries.description: Returns the sideways tilt (roll) of the entity's head, or 0.0 for entities where this does not apply.

queries.name: head_x_rotation
queries.summary: Pitch of one of the entity's heads
queries.description: Returns the X (pitch) rotation of the entity's head with the given index, or 0.0 when it does not apply. Most entities have one head, index 0.
notes: Takes exactly one argument; pass 0 for single-headed entities.
An out-of-range head index logs an error.

queries.name: head_y_rotation
queries.summary: Yaw of one of the entity's heads
queries.description: Returns the Y (yaw) rotation of the entity's head, or 0.0 when it does not apply. The argument is normally the head index (0 for most entities).

args.name: head_or_clamp
args.description: Head index (0..2 for the wither, otherwise 0), or a clamp angle in degrees for horse-like mobs

notes: Takes one argument. Horses, donkeys, mules and skeleton/zombie horses read it as a clamp in degrees; the wither reads it as a head index 0..2; everything else expects 0.
Interpolated per frame, so it is only fully meaningful while rendering.

queries.name: health
queries.summary: Current health of the entity
queries.description: Returns the entity's current health points, or 0.0 when the entity has no health.

queries.name: heartbeat_interval
queries.summary: Time between the entity's heartbeats, in seconds
queries.description: Returns the interval between the entity's heartbeats in seconds (as used by the warden), or 0 when it has no heartbeat.

queries.name: heartbeat_phase
queries.summary: Progress through the current heartbeat (0..1)
queries.description: Gives the entity's position within its current heartbeat as a fraction: 0.0 as a beat begins, rising to 1.0 as it finishes. Entities without a heartbeat report 0.
notes: Resource packs only: on the server side (behavior packs) it does not return a meaningful value.

queries.name: heightmap
queries.summary: Terrain height at a given x, z column
queries.description: Returns the terrain heightmap value for the world column at the given x and z.
notes: World generation only: available in feature and feature-rule expressions, not in entity or resource pack Molang.

queries.name: hurt_direction
queries.summary: Direction the entity was last hurt from
queries.description: Returns a value describing the direction of the last hit the entity took, or 0 when not applicable.

queries.name: hurt_time
queries.summary: Time left on the entity's hurt effect
queries.description: Returns the entity's hurt time, which is non-zero for a short while after it takes damage; 0 when it is not hurt or the query does not apply.

queries.name: in_range
queries.summary: Whether a value lies within a range (inclusive)
queries.description: Returns 1.0 if `value` is between `min` and `max`, including both ends, otherwise 0.0.
notes: Takes exactly three numeric arguments.

queries.name: invulnerable_ticks
queries.summary: Ticks of invulnerability the entity has left
queries.description: Returns the number of ticks the entity remains invulnerable (for example after taking damage), or 0.0 when not applicable.

queries.name: is_admiring
queries.summary: Whether the entity is admiring an item
queries.description: Returns 1.0 while the entity is admiring an item (as piglins do with gold), otherwise 0.0.

queries.name: is_alive
queries.summary: Whether the entity is alive
queries.description: Returns 1.0 while the entity is alive and 0.0 once it has died.

queries.name: is_angry
queries.summary: Whether the entity is angry
queries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is angry, otherwise 0.0.

queries.name: is_attached
queries.summary: Whether the entity is attached to another entity
queries.description: Returns 1.0 if this entity is attached to another one, such as being held or worn, otherwise 0.0.
notes: Resource packs only: using it in a behavior pack logs an error.
Must be evaluated on an entity.

queries.name: is_attached_to_entity
queries.summary: Whether the actor is attached to an entity
queries.description: Returns 1.0 if this actor is attached to an entity, otherwise 0.0.

queries.name: is_avoiding_block
queries.summary: Whether the entity is fleeing from a block
queries.description: Returns 1.0 while the entity is running away from a block (for example a hoglin avoiding warped fungus), otherwise 0.0.

queries.name: is_avoiding_mobs
queries.summary: Whether the entity is fleeing from other mobs
queries.description: Returns 1.0 while the entity is running away from mobs, otherwise 0.0.

queries.name: is_baby
queries.summary: Whether the entity is a baby
queries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is a baby, otherwise 0.0.

queries.name: is_breathing
queries.summary: Whether the entity is breathing
queries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is currently breathing, otherwise 0.0.

queries.name: is_bribed
queries.summary: Whether the entity has been bribed
queries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity has been bribed, otherwise 0.0.

queries.name: is_carrying_block
queries.summary: Whether the entity is carrying a block
queries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is carrying a block, otherwise 0.0.
notes: Behaviour differs by file version: files at Molang version 1.21.100 or newer use a newer implementation than older files, so results can differ for the same entity.

queries.name: is_casting
queries.summary: Whether the entity is casting a spell
queries.description: Returns 1.0 while the entity is casting (as evokers and illusioners do), otherwise 0.0.

queries.name: is_celebrating
queries.summary: Whether the entity is celebrating
queries.description: Returns 1.0 while the entity is celebrating (for example raiders after a won raid), otherwise 0.0.

queries.name: is_celebrating_special
queries.summary: Whether the entity is performing its special celebration
queries.description: Returns 1.0 while the entity is in its special celebration state, otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_charged
queries.summary: Whether the entity's charged state is set
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the entity is flagged as charged, otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.
notes: Distinct from `query.is_powered`.

queries.name: is_charging
queries.summary: Whether the entity is charging up or charging at a target
queries.description: Returns 1.0 while the entity is in its charging state (for example a vex swooping at its target), otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_chested
queries.summary: Whether the entity has a chest attached
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when a chest has been fitted to the entity, as with a donkey, mule or llama, otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_cooldown_category
queries.summary: Whether an item in a slot belongs to a given cooldown category
queries.description: Returns 1.0 if the item in the given equipment slot uses the named cooldown category, otherwise 0.0. The slot name and index follow the same naming as the `/replaceitem` command.

args.name: category
args.description: Cooldown category name to look for

args.name: slot_index
args.description: Slot index; required for slots with several indices, e.g. 'slot.hotbar'

notes: Pass two or three arguments, even though the published argument range says one or two. Other counts log a content error.
The third argument is required when the slot name has more than one index (hotbar, inventory and similar).

queries.name: is_crawling
queries.summary: Whether the entity is crawling
queries.description: Returns 1.0 while the entity is crawling (for example a player squeezed into a one-block-high gap), otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_critical
queries.summary: Whether the entity is flagged as critical
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the entity carries the critical flag (for example an arrow fired at full draw), otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_croaking
queries.summary: Whether the entity is croaking
queries.description: Returns 1.0 while the entity is croaking, as a frog does, otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_dancing
queries.summary: Whether the entity is dancing
queries.description: Returns 1.0 while the entity is dancing (for example a parrot or allay near a playing jukebox), otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_delayed_attacking
queries.summary: Whether the entity is performing a delayed attack
queries.description: Returns 1.0 while the entity is carrying out an attack from its delayed-attack behaviour, otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_digging
queries.summary: Whether the entity is digging
queries.description: Returns 1.0 while the entity is digging (for example the warden burrowing back into the ground), otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_eating
queries.summary: Whether the entity is eating
queries.description: Returns 1.0 while the entity is eating, otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_eating_mob
queries.summary: Whether the entity is eating another mob
queries.description: Returns 1.0 while the entity is eating a mob (for example a frog swallowing its prey), otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_elder
queries.summary: Whether the entity is the elder variant
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the entity is the elder version of its kind, such as an elder guardian, otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_emerging
queries.summary: Whether the entity is emerging
queries.description: Returns 1.0 while the entity is emerging (for example the warden rising out of the ground), otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_emoting
queries.summary: Whether the entity is playing an emote
queries.description: Returns 1.0 while the entity (normally a player) is performing an emote, otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_enchanted
queries.summary: Whether the entity is flagged as enchanted
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the entity carries the enchanted flag, otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_feeling_happy
queries.summary: Whether timer flag 2 is running (deprecated)
queries.description: Returns 1.0 while the entity's `behavior.timer_flag_2` is running, otherwise 0.0. It is the same check as `query.timer_flag_2`. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.
notes: Deprecated: use `query.timer_flag_2` instead.
Not available in files whose version is 1.20.50 or newer; there it fails to resolve as an unknown query.

versionGate.meaning: resolvable only while the file's Molang version is below this SemVersion; unknown-query error at/after it

queries.name: is_fire_immune
queries.summary: Whether the entity is immune to fire
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when fire does not harm the entity, otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_first_person
queries.summary: Whether the entity is being rendered in first person
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the entity is being drawn from the first-person view, otherwise 0.0.
notes: Only meaningful in client entity and attachable files; everywhere else it always returns 0.0.

queries.name: is_ghost
queries.summary: Whether the entity is flagged as a ghost
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the entity carries the ghost flag, otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_gliding
queries.summary: Whether the entity is gliding
queries.description: Returns 1.0 while the entity is gliding, for example a player flying with an elytra, otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_grazing
queries.summary: Whether the entity is grazing
queries.description: Returns 1.0 while the entity is grazing, otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_idling
queries.summary: Whether the entity is idling
queries.description: Returns 1.0 while the entity is in its idling state, otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_ignited
queries.summary: Whether the entity is ignited
queries.description: Returns 1.0 while the entity is ignited, for example a creeper whose fuse is burning, otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_illager_captain
queries.summary: Whether the entity is an illager captain
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the entity is a raid or patrol captain (the one carrying the banner), otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_in_contact_with_water
queries.summary: Whether the entity touches any kind of water
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the entity is in contact with water in any form: water blocks, rain, or a splash water bottle. Otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_in_lava
queries.summary: Whether the entity is in lava
queries.description: Returns 1.0 while the entity is in lava, otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_in_love
queries.summary: Whether the entity is in love mode
queries.description: Returns 1.0 while the entity is in love mode and ready to breed, otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_in_ui
queries.summary: Whether the entity is being rendered in a UI screen
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the entity is drawn as part of the user interface (for example the player preview in the inventory), otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.
notes: Useful only in client-side (resource pack) files.

queries.name: is_in_water
queries.summary: Whether the entity is in water
queries.description: Returns 1.0 while the entity is in water, otherwise 0.0. Rain does not count; see `query.is_in_water_or_rain`. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_in_water_or_rain
queries.summary: Whether the entity is in water or standing in rain
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the entity is in water or exposed to rain, otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_interested
queries.summary: Whether the entity is showing interest
queries.description: Returns 1.0 while the entity is in its interested state, otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_invisible
queries.summary: Whether the entity is invisible
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the entity is invisible, for example from an invisibility effect, otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_item_equipped
queries.summary: Whether there is an item in the main hand or off hand
queries.description: Returns 1.0 if the given hand holds an item, otherwise 0.0. With no argument it checks the main hand.

args.name: hand
args.description: 0 or 'main_hand' for the main hand, 1 or 'off_hand' for the off hand

notes: Any other hand value logs a content error.

queries.name: is_item_name_any
queries.summary: Whether the item in a slot has any of the given names
queries.description: Checks the item held or worn in one equipment slot against a list of item identifiers and gives 1.0 on the first match, otherwise 0.0. Each identifier needs its namespace (`minecraft:`). An empty string `''` matches an empty slot.

args.name: slot_name
args.description: Equipment slot name, as used by /replaceitem

args.name: slot_index
args.description: Slot index; required for slots with several indices, e.g. 'slot.hotbar'

args.name: item_name
args.description: Full item identifier to match; repeat for more

notes: Needs at least two arguments: the slot name and at least one item name.
