queries.name: is_jump_goal_jumping
queries.summary: Whether the entity is jumping as part of a jump goal
queries.description: Returns 1.0 while the entity is in the middle of a jump started by its jump goal, otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_jumping
queries.summary: Whether the entity is jumping
queries.description: Returns 1.0 while the entity is jumping, otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_laying_down
queries.summary: Whether the entity is lying down
queries.description: Returns 1.0 while the entity is lying down, otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_laying_egg
queries.summary: Whether the entity is laying an egg
queries.description: Returns 1.0 while the entity is laying an egg, as a turtle does on its home beach, otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_leashed
queries.summary: Whether the entity is on a lead
queries.description: Returns 1.0 while the entity is leashed to something, otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_levitating
queries.summary: Whether the entity is levitating
queries.description: Returns 1.0 while the entity is levitating, otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_lingering
queries.summary: Whether the entity is flagged as lingering
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the entity carries the lingering flag, otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_local_player
queries.summary: Whether the entity is the local player of this game window
queries.description: Gives 1.0 for the player who is controlled through the game window doing the rendering, otherwise 0.0. With split-screen, each view only reports 1.0 for its own player.
notes: Takes no arguments.
Always returns 0.0 in behavior packs; use it in resource pack files.

queries.name: is_moving
queries.summary: Whether the entity is moving
queries.description: Returns 1.0 while the entity is moving, otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_name_any
queries.summary: Whether the entity's name matches any of the given strings
queries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity's name equals any of the listed strings, otherwise 0.0.

args.name: name
args.description: Name to match; repeat for more

notes: Every argument must be a string; anything else logs a content error.
Prefer this over the deprecated `query.get_name`.

queries.name: is_on_fire
queries.summary: Whether the entity is on fire
queries.description: Returns 1.0 while the entity is burning, otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_on_ground
queries.summary: Whether the entity is standing on the ground
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the entity is on the ground, otherwise 0.0 (for example while jumping, falling or flying). Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_on_screen
queries.summary: Whether the entity's on-screen status is known
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the call happens at a point where the game has determined whether the entity is on screen, otherwise 0.0. It does not by itself tell you that the entity is visible.
notes: Only meaningful in client-side (resource pack) files.

queries.name: is_onfire
queries.summary: Whether the entity is on fire (alternate spelling)
queries.description: Returns 1.0 while the entity is burning, otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.
notes: Alternate spelling of `query.is_on_fire`; prefer that one in new content.

queries.name: is_orphaned
queries.summary: Whether the entity is flagged as orphaned
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the entity carries the orphaned flag, otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_owner_identifier_any
queries.summary: Whether the root owning entity's identifier matches any given one
queries.description: Returns 1.0 if the identifier of the root entity (the top-level owner, such as the entity holding an attachable) equals any of the listed strings, otherwise 0.0.

args.name: identifier
args.description: Entity identifier with namespace; repeat for more

notes: Every argument must be a string; anything else logs a content error.
Prefer this over the deprecated `query.owner_identifier`.

queries.name: is_pack_setting_enabled
queries.summary: Whether a resource pack's toggle setting is switched on
queries.description: Returns 1.0 if the named Pack Setting toggle is enabled, otherwise 0.0.
notes: Resource packs only; behavior packs cannot use pack settings queries.
Must be used where there is an entity or level context.
An unknown setting name logs a content error.

queries.name: is_pack_setting_selected
queries.summary: Whether a dropdown pack setting has a given option selected
queries.description: Returns 1.0 if the named Pack Setting dropdown or multi-select has the given option selected, otherwise 0.0.

args.name: setting
args.description: Name of the dropdown or multi-select setting

args.name: option
args.description: Name of the option to test for

notes: Resource packs only; behavior packs cannot use pack settings queries.
Must be used where there is an entity or level context.
Both arguments must be strings, and the setting must exist.

queries.name: is_persona_or_premium_skin
queries.summary: Whether the player uses a character-creator or premium skin
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the player is wearing a persona (character creator) skin or a premium skin, otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_playing_dead
queries.summary: Whether the entity is playing dead
queries.description: Returns 1.0 while the entity is playing dead, as an axolotl does, otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_powered
queries.summary: Whether the entity is powered
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the entity is powered, for example a creeper charged by lightning, otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_pregnant
queries.summary: Whether the entity is carrying young or eggs
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the entity is flagged as pregnant (for example a turtle that has bred and is about to lay eggs), otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_ram_attacking
queries.summary: Whether the entity is performing a ram attack
queries.description: Returns 1.0 while the entity is ramming, as a goat does, otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_resting
queries.summary: Whether the entity is resting
queries.description: Returns 1.0 while the entity is resting, for example a bat hanging upside down, otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_riding
queries.summary: Whether the entity is riding another entity
queries.description: Returns 1.0 while the entity is riding something, otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_riding_any_entity_of_type
queries.summary: Whether the entity rides an entity of any of the given types
queries.description: Returns 1.0 if the entity is currently riding an entity whose type identifier matches any of the listed strings, otherwise 0.0.

args.name: identifier
args.description: Entity type identifier with namespace; repeat for more

notes: Needs at least one argument, and every argument must be a string.

queries.name: is_rising
queries.summary: Whether timer flag 2 is running (deprecated)
queries.description: Returns 1.0 while the entity's `behavior.timer_flag_2` is running, otherwise 0.0. It is the same check as `query.timer_flag_2`. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.
notes: Deprecated: use `query.timer_flag_2` instead.
Not available in files whose version is 1.20.50 or newer; there it fails to resolve as an unknown query.

versionGate.meaning: resolvable only while the file's Molang version is below this SemVersion; unknown-query error at/after it

queries.name: is_roaring
queries.summary: Whether the entity is roaring
queries.description: Returns 1.0 while the entity is roaring (for example a ravager after being stunned), otherwise 0.0. Returns 0.0 when there is no entity.

queries.name: is_rolling
queries.summary: Whether the entity is rolling
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the entity is rolling, otherwise 0.0. Vanilla uses this for pandas tumbling over.

queries.name: is_saddled
queries.summary: Whether the entity is wearing a saddle
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the entity has a saddle equipped, otherwise 0.0.

queries.name: is_scared
queries.summary: Whether the entity is in its scared state
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the entity is in its scared state, otherwise 0.0. Only mobs that have a scared state (such as a panda during a thunderstorm) ever report 1.0.

queries.name: is_scenting
queries.summary: Whether the entity's first behavior timer flag is running (deprecated)
queries.description: Returns 1.0 while the entity's `timer_flag_1` behavior is running, otherwise 0.0.
notes: Deprecated, with no direct replacement.
Fails to resolve in content whose Molang version is 1.20.50 or newer.

versionGate.meaning: resolvable only while the file's Molang version is below this SemVersion; unknown-query error at/after it

queries.name: is_searching
queries.summary: Whether the entity is in its searching state
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the entity is in its searching state, otherwise 0.0.

queries.name: is_selected_item
queries.summary: Whether the player is holding an item in the selected hotbar slot
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the entity is a player whose selected slot holds an item, otherwise 0.0. Always 0.0 for entities that are not players.
notes: Only players can return 1.0.

queries.name: is_shaking
queries.summary: Whether the entity has its shaking state set
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the entity's shaking status is set, otherwise 0.0.
notes: Not the same as `q.is_shaking_wetness`, which tracks shaking off water.

queries.name: is_shaking_wetness
queries.summary: Whether the entity is shaking water off (e.g. a wet wolf)
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the entity is shaking water off its body, otherwise 0.0.

queries.name: is_sheared
queries.summary: Whether the entity has been sheared
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the entity has been sheared, otherwise 0.0. Entities that cannot be sheared always return 0.0.

queries.name: is_shield_powered
queries.summary: Whether the entity has its powered shield active
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the entity currently has a powered shield up, otherwise 0.0. Entities without such a shield always give 0.0.

queries.name: is_silent
queries.summary: Whether the entity is flagged as silent
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the entity is flagged as silent, otherwise 0.0.

queries.name: is_sitting
queries.summary: Whether the entity is sitting
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the entity is sitting, otherwise 0.0.

queries.name: is_sleeping
queries.summary: Whether the entity is sleeping
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the entity is sleeping, otherwise 0.0.

queries.name: is_sneaking
queries.summary: Whether the entity is sneaking
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the entity is sneaking, otherwise 0.0.

queries.name: is_sneezing
queries.summary: Whether the entity is sneezing
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the entity is sneezing, otherwise 0.0. Vanilla uses this for panda sneezes.

queries.name: is_sniffing
queries.summary: Whether the entity is sniffing
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the entity is sniffing, otherwise 0.0.

queries.name: is_sonic_boom
queries.summary: Whether the entity is using its sonic boom attack (e.g. the Warden)
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the entity is performing a sonic boom attack, otherwise 0.0.

queries.name: is_spectator
queries.summary: Whether the entity is a player in spectator mode
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the entity is in spectator mode, otherwise 0.0.

queries.name: is_sprinting
queries.summary: Whether the entity is sprinting
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the entity is sprinting, otherwise 0.0.

queries.name: is_stackable
queries.summary: Whether the entity has its stackable flag set
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the entity has its stackable flag set, otherwise 0.0.

queries.name: is_stalking
queries.summary: Whether the entity is stalking
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the entity is stalking, otherwise 0.0. Vanilla uses this for a fox creeping up on prey.

queries.name: is_standing
queries.summary: Whether the entity is in its standing state
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the entity is in its standing state, otherwise 0.0. Used by mobs that rear up or stand on their hind legs.

queries.name: is_stunned
queries.summary: Whether the entity is currently stunned
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the entity is currently stunned, otherwise 0.0. Vanilla uses this for a ravager stunned after its attack is blocked.

queries.name: is_swimming
queries.summary: Whether the entity is swimming
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the entity is swimming, otherwise 0.0.

queries.name: is_tamed
queries.summary: Whether the entity is tamed
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the entity is tamed, otherwise 0.0.

queries.name: is_transforming
queries.summary: Whether the entity is transforming
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the entity is transforming, otherwise 0.0.

queries.name: is_using_item
queries.summary: Whether the entity is using an item
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the entity is using an item, otherwise 0.0. Covers hold-to-use actions such as drawing a bow, eating or blocking.

queries.name: is_wall_climbing
queries.summary: Whether the entity is climbing a wall
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the entity is climbing a wall, otherwise 0.0. Vanilla spiders use this.

queries.name: item_in_use_duration
queries.summary: How long the held item has been in use
queries.description: Reports the time, in seconds, that the item in hand has spent being used so far, stopping at the item's maximum use duration. Gives 0.0 when there is no item use to measure.

queries.name: item_is_charged
queries.summary: Whether the item in a hand is charged (e.g. a loaded crossbow)
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the item in the requested hand is charged, otherwise 0.0. Without an argument the main hand is checked.

args.name: hand
args.description: `0` or `'main_hand'` for the main hand, `1` or `'off_hand'` for the off hand

notes: The hand can be a number or a string; any other value logs a content-log error.

queries.name: item_max_use_duration
queries.summary: Maximum use duration of the held item
queries.description: Gives the longest time the held item can be used for (for example how long a bow can be drawn or food takes to eat). Gives 0.0 when that does not apply.

queries.name: item_remaining_use_duration
queries.summary: Time left before the held item finishes being used
queries.description: Reports how much use time is left on the item in the chosen hand. Without a normalization value the result is in seconds; with one, the remaining time is scaled by that value instead. Gives 0.0 when there is nothing to measure.

args.name: normalize
args.description: Scale for the remaining fraction, e.g. 1.0 for a 0..1 result

notes: Accepts at most two arguments: a slot name first, then a numeric normalization value.
Files whose Molang version is below 1.17.30 get an older variant of this query that behaves differently.
More than two arguments, an unknown slot name, or arguments of the wrong type log a content-log error.

queries.name: item_slot_to_bone_name
queries.summary: Name of the bone an equipment slot is attached to
queries.description: Returns, as a string, the name of the bone that the entity's model maps to the given equipment slot.
notes: Returns a string, so it cannot be used directly in arithmetic.
Needs an owning entity; on an attachable whose item has no owner it logs a content-log error.

queries.name: key_frame_lerp_time
queries.summary: Blend ratio between the previous and next animation keyframes
queries.description: Gives how far playback has moved from the previous keyframe toward the next one in the current animation, as a ratio.
notes: Only meaningful inside an animation; elsewhere it returns a default value.

queries.name: kinetic_weapon_damage_duration
queries.summary: `damage_conditions` max duration of the main-hand kinetic weapon
queries.description: Returns the `max_duration` set in `damage_conditions` of the `minecraft:kinetic_weapon` component on the main-hand item. Returns 0.0 when the held item has no such component.
notes: Returns the value as written in the item's JSON.

queries.name: kinetic_weapon_delay
queries.summary: `delay` of the main-hand item's kinetic weapon component
queries.description: Returns the `delay` value from the `minecraft:kinetic_weapon` component on the main-hand item. Returns 0.0 when the held item has no such component.
notes: Returns the value as written in the item's JSON.

queries.name: kinetic_weapon_dismount_duration
queries.summary: `dismount_conditions` max duration of the main-hand kinetic weapon
queries.description: Returns the `max_duration` set in `dismount_conditions` of the `minecraft:kinetic_weapon` component on the main-hand item. Returns 0.0 when the held item has no such component.
notes: Returns the value as written in the item's JSON.

queries.name: kinetic_weapon_knockback_duration
queries.summary: `knockback_conditions` max duration of the main-hand kinetic weapon
queries.description: Returns the `max_duration` set in `knockback_conditions` of the `minecraft:kinetic_weapon` component on the main-hand item. Returns 0.0 when the held item has no such component.
notes: Returns the value as written in the item's JSON.

queries.name: last_frame_time
queries.summary: Duration of a recent rendered frame, in seconds
queries.description: Returns how long a previous frame took, in seconds. With no argument (or `0`) it gives the frame before the current one; `1` gives the one before that, and so on.

args.name: frames_back
args.description: How many frames further back to look; defaults to 0

notes: Client only: use it in resource packs.
Only a limited frame history is kept; asking beyond it returns the oldest stored frame.

queries.name: last_hit_by_player
queries.summary: Whether the entity was last hit by a player
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the most recent hit on the entity came from a player, otherwise 0.0.
notes: Server-side information: on the client it always returns 0.0, so it is only useful in behavior packs.

queries.name: last_input_mode_is_any
queries.summary: Whether the player's last input came from any of the given input modes
queries.description: Returns 1.0 when the most recently used input method matches any of the listed modes, otherwise 0.0.
notes: Client only: use it in resource packs.

queries.name: leashed_entity_count
queries.summary: Number of entities leashed to this entity
queries.description: Returns how many entities currently have this entity as their leash holder.

queries.name: lie_amount
queries.summary: How far the entity has settled into lying down
queries.description: Returns the entity's lying-down progress, smoothed between frames. Vanilla cats use it to blend into their lying pose.
notes: Depends on per-frame interpolation, so it is only meaningful on the client; on the server and in entity-bound particles it returns a default value.

queries.name: life_span
queries.summary: The entity's limited lifetime, or 0 if it lives forever
queries.description: Gives the entity's limited lifetime, or 0.0 if it is allowed to live indefinitely.

queries.name: life_time
queries.summary: Seconds since the current animation started
queries.description: Returns the time in seconds since the current animation began playing. Returns 0.0 outside an animation.
notes: Despite the name, this is animation time, not the entity's age.
Only meaningful inside an animation; elsewhere it returns 0.0.

queries.name: lod_index
queries.summary: Which distance band from the camera the entity is in
queries.description: Takes a list of increasing distances and returns the zero-based index of the first one the entity is closer than, or the number of distances given if it is farther than all of them. For example, `q.lod_index(10, 20, 30)` returns 0, 1, 2 or 3.

args.name: distance
args.description: Distance threshold in blocks; repeat, from nearest to farthest

notes: Needs a camera distance, so it has no useful value on the server or in block contexts.
Thresholds are checked in order and the first match wins, so list them from nearest to farthest.
With no arguments it returns 0.

queries.name: log
queries.summary: Write values to the content log for debugging
queries.description: Prints its argument to the content log. Meant for debugging expressions while developing a pack.
notes: Debugging aid: it writes to the content log every time it is evaluated, which can flood the log in per-frame expressions.

queries.name: main_hand_item_max_duration
queries.summary: Maximum use duration of the main-hand item
queries.description: Gives the maximum use duration of the item held in the main hand. Returns 0.0 when the hand is empty or the item is not used over time.

queries.name: main_hand_item_use_duration
queries.summary: Use time of the main-hand item
queries.description: Reports the use time of the item held in the main hand.
notes: Compare it with `q.main_hand_item_max_duration` to relate it to the item's full use time.

queries.name: mark_variant
queries.summary: The entity's mark variant number
queries.description: Returns the value set by the entity's `minecraft:mark_variant` component, often used to pick secondary textures or patterns. Returns 0.0 if none is set.

queries.name: max_durability
queries.summary: Maximum durability of the item
queries.description: Returns the maximum durability of the item being evaluated.
notes: Only works where an item is the subject, such as an item's `repair_amount` expression; elsewhere it logs a content-log error and returns 0.0.

queries.name: max_health
queries.summary: Maximum health of the entity
queries.description: Returns the entity's maximum health, or 0.0 if the entity has no health.

queries.name: max_trade_tier
queries.summary: Highest trade tier the entity can reach
queries.description: Returns the maximum trade tier of a trading entity such as a villager, or 0.0 when it does not trade.

queries.name: maximum_frame_time
queries.summary: The longest frame time over recent frames, in seconds
queries.description: Returns the time in seconds of the most expensive frame among recent frames. With no argument (or `0`) only the frame before the current one is considered; passing `n` covers the last `n + 1` frames.

args.name: frames
args.description: How many extra frames back to include; defaults to 0

notes: Client only: use it in resource packs.
Only a limited frame history is kept; asking for more frames samples just what is stored.

queries.name: minimum_frame_time
queries.summary: The shortest frame time over recent frames, in seconds
queries.description: Returns the time in seconds of the cheapest frame among recent frames. With no argument (or `0`) only the frame before the current one is considered; passing `n` covers the last `n + 1` frames.

args.name: frames
args.description: How many extra frames back to include; defaults to 0

notes: Client only: use it in resource packs.
Only a limited frame history is kept; asking for more frames samples just what is stored.

queries.name: model_scale
queries.summary: Render scale of the current entity model
queries.description: Returns the scale the entity's model is rendered at.
notes: Only meaningful while rendering an entity; on the server and in particles it returns a default value.

queries.name: modified_distance_moved
queries.summary: Horizontal distance travelled, scaled by status (baby, on fire, ...)
queries.description: Accumulates how far the entity has travelled horizontally, in blocks, with the amount scaled by conditions like being a baby or burning. The count restarts whenever the entity is loaded again, so it is not a lifetime total.
notes: Because it restarts on reload, treat it as a walk-cycle phase rather than an odometer.

queries.name: modified_move_speed
queries.summary: Current walk speed, scaled by status (baby, on fire, ...)
queries.description: Gives the entity's present walking speed, scaled by conditions like being a baby or burning. Commonly used to scale walk-cycle amplitude.

queries.name: modified_swing_duration
queries.summary: Length of the entity's swing or attack animation
queries.description: Gives how long the entity's arm swing or attack takes, based on the item it holds and adjusted by active status effects.

queries.name: moon_brightness
queries.summary: Brightness of the current moon phase (0..1)
queries.description: Returns the moon's brightness for the current phase: 1.0 at full moon, 0.75 when gibbous, 0.5 at a quarter, 0.25 when crescent and 0.0 at new moon.

queries.name: moon_phase
queries.summary: Current moon phase index (0 = full moon, 4 = new moon)
queries.description: Returns the current moon phase as a whole number from 0 to 7: 0 full moon, 1 waning gibbous, 2 first quarter, 3 waning crescent, 4 new moon, 5 waxing crescent, 6 last quarter, 7 waxing gibbous.
notes: The phase names follow the game's own labels, which do not match the real-world order of phases.

queries.name: movement_direction
queries.summary: One axis of the entity's normalized movement direction
queries.description: Returns the x, y or z component of the entity's normalized change in position, in the range -1..1.

args.name: axis
args.description: 0 for x, 1 for y, 2 for z

notes: The axis must be 0, 1 or 2; anything else logs a content-log error.

queries.name: noise
queries.summary: Simplex noise value at an (x, z) position
queries.description: Samples smooth Perlin simplex noise at the given x and z coordinates. The same position always gives the same value.
notes: World generation only: available in feature and feature-rule expressions, not in entity, block or resource-pack Molang.

queries.name: on_fire_time
queries.summary: The entity's fire time, or 0 when not burning
queries.description: Gives the entity's current fire time, or 0.0 when it is not on fire.

queries.name: out_of_control
queries.summary: Whether the entity is currently out of control
queries.description: Gives `1` when the entity is in its out-of-control state and `0` otherwise.

queries.name: overlay_alpha
queries.summary: Deprecated query with no documented meaning; avoid it
queries.description: A deprecated query kept for old content. The game gives no description of what it reports beyond its name, and it is slated for removal, so new content should not use it.
notes: Deprecated with no replacement. It may be removed in a future release.

queries.name: owner_identifier
queries.summary: Identifier of the root entity (deprecated; use is_owner_identifier_any)
queries.description: Returns the identifier of the root entity as a string, for example `'minecraft:player'`. Prefer `query.is_owner_identifier_any`, which keeps working if identifiers are renamed later.
notes: Deprecated: use `query.is_owner_identifier_any('namespace:name')` instead.
Returns a string, so you can only compare it with `==`/`!=`. It cannot be used in arithmetic.

queries.name: player_level
queries.summary: The player's experience level
queries.description: Returns the player's experience level. Returns `0` when the entity is not a player.

queries.name: position
queries.summary: World position of the entity along one axis
queries.description: Returns the entity's absolute world position on the requested axis, in blocks. Pass `0` for x, `1` for y or `2` for z.
notes: The axis argument is required. Values outside 0..2 log a content error.

queries.name: position_delta
queries.summary: How far the entity moved on one axis since the last tick
queries.description: Returns how much the entity's position changed on the requested axis since the previous update, in blocks. Pass `0` for x, `1` for y or `2` for z.
notes: The axis argument is required. Values outside 0..2 log a content error.

queries.name: previous_squish_value
queries.summary: Squish amount from the previous frame (slime-style bounce)
queries.description: Returns the entity's squish value from the previous update, as used by slime-like bounce animations. Returns `0` for entities that don't squish.

queries.name: property
queries.summary: Value of an entity property by name
queries.description: Returns the current value of the named entity property (as declared in the entity's `description.properties`). Returns `0` if the entity has no such property.
notes: The name argument must be a string, e.g. `'my_pack:mood'`.
Enum properties are compared against a string, e.g. `q.property('my_pack:mood') == 'angry'`.
A missing property logs a content error; check first with `query.has_property` if the property may not exist.

queries.name: relative_block_has_all_tags
queries.summary: Whether the block at an offset from the entity has every listed tag
queries.description: Looks at the block at the given x/y/z offset from the entity and returns `1` if it has all of the listed block tags, otherwise `0`.

args.name: x
args.description: X offset from the entity, in blocks

args.name: y
args.description: Y offset from the entity, in blocks

args.name: z
args.description: Z offset from the entity, in blocks

args.name: tag
args.description: Block tag; repeat for more tags

notes: Needs at least four arguments: three offsets and one or more tags. Any number of additional tags may follow.
Tags must be string literals in single quotes.
Requires an entity; it does not work in particle, block or item-only contexts.

queries.name: relative_block_has_any_tag
queries.summary: Whether the block at an offset from the entity has any listed tag
queries.description: Looks at the block at the given x/y/z offset from the entity and returns `1` if it has at least one of the listed block tags, otherwise `0`.

args.name: x
args.description: X offset from the entity, in blocks

args.name: y
args.description: Y offset from the entity, in blocks

args.name: z
args.description: Z offset from the entity, in blocks

args.name: tag
args.description: Block tag; repeat for more tags

notes: Needs at least four arguments: three offsets and one or more tags. Any number of additional tags may follow.
Tags must be string literals in single quotes.
Requires an entity; it does not work in particle, block or item-only contexts.

queries.name: remaining_durability
queries.summary: Durability left on the current item
queries.description: Returns how many durability points the item has left. Only meaningful where an item is in scope, such as an attachable.
notes: Needs an item context (e.g. attachables). Without an item it logs a content error.

queries.name: ride_body_x_rotation
queries.summary: Body pitch of the entity this one is riding, in degrees
queries.description: Returns the world-space body pitch (x rotation) of the entity's mount, in degrees. Returns `0` when the entity isn't riding anything.
notes: Takes no arguments. Passing any logs a content error.

queries.name: ride_body_y_rotation
queries.summary: Body yaw of the entity this one is riding, in degrees
queries.description: Returns the world-space body yaw (y rotation) of the entity's mount, in degrees. Returns `0` when the entity isn't riding anything.
notes: Takes no arguments. Passing any logs a content error.

queries.name: ride_head_x_rotation
queries.summary: Head pitch of the entity this one is riding, in degrees
queries.description: Returns the world-space head pitch (x rotation) of the entity's mount, in degrees. Returns `0` when the entity isn't riding anything.
notes: Takes no arguments. Passing any logs a content error.

queries.name: ride_head_y_rotation
queries.summary: Head yaw of the entity this one is riding, in degrees
queries.description: Returns the world-space head yaw (y rotation) of the entity's mount, in degrees. Returns `0` when the entity isn't riding anything. The optional argument clamps the result.

args.name: clamp_degrees
args.description: Clamp limit in degrees; needed for horse-type mounts

notes: When the mount is a horse, donkey, mule, skeleton horse or zombie horse the clamp argument is required.
Accepts zero or one argument; more logs a content error.

queries.name: rider_body_x_rotation
queries.summary: Body pitch of the rider at a given seat index, in degrees
queries.description: Returns the world-space body pitch (x rotation) of the rider at the given index, in degrees. Returns `0` when there is no such rider.
notes: The index is required and must be a valid rider index; an out-of-range index logs a content error.

queries.name: rider_body_y_rotation
queries.summary: Body yaw of the rider at a given seat index, in degrees
queries.description: Returns the world-space body yaw (y rotation) of the rider at the given index, in degrees. Returns `0` when there is no such rider.
notes: The index is required and must be a valid rider index; an out-of-range index logs a content error.

queries.name: rider_head_x_rotation
queries.summary: Head pitch of the rider at a given seat index, in degrees
queries.description: Returns the world-space head pitch (x rotation) of the rider at the given index, in degrees. Returns `0` when there is no such rider.
notes: The index is required and must be a valid rider index; an out-of-range index logs a content error.

queries.name: rider_head_y_rotation
queries.summary: Head yaw of the rider at a given seat index, in degrees
queries.description: Returns the world-space head yaw (y rotation) of the rider at the given index, in degrees. Returns `0` when there is no such rider. The optional second argument clamps the result.

args.name: clamp_degrees
args.description: Clamp limit in degrees; needed on horse-type entities

notes: On horses, donkeys, mules, skeleton horses and zombie horses the clamp argument is required.
The index must be a valid rider index; an out-of-range index logs a content error.

queries.name: roll_counter
queries.summary: The entity's roll counter (e.g. a rolling panda)
queries.description: Gives the entity's current roll counter, useful for driving a rolling animation such as the panda's.

queries.name: rotation_to_camera
queries.summary: Rotation needed to face the camera on one axis, in degrees
queries.description: Returns the rotation, in degrees, that would make the entity face the camera. Pass `0` for the x (pitch) rotation or `1` for the y (yaw) rotation.
notes: Client only: use it in resource pack files (client entities, animations, render controllers, particles).

queries.name: scoreboard
queries.summary: This entity's score on a scoreboard objective
queries.description: Returns the entity's score for the named scoreboard objective.
notes: Behavior packs only; it does not work in resource pack files.
Must be evaluated on an entity.
The objective name must be a string literal in single quotes.

queries.name: server_memory_tier
queries.summary: Memory tier of the server, 0 (lowest) to 4 (highest)
queries.description: Returns the server's RAM tier: `0` super low, `1` low, `2` mid, `3` high, `4` super high.
notes: Behavior packs only; it does not work in resource pack files.
Must be evaluated in an entity context.

queries.name: shake_angle
queries.summary: The entity's current shaking angle
queries.description: Returns the entity's shaking angle, such as a wolf shaking off water. Returns `0` for entities that don't shake.

queries.name: shake_time
queries.summary: The entity's shake timer
queries.description: Gives the entity's shake timer, which relates to shaking animations such as a wet wolf drying off.

queries.name: shield_blocking_bob
queries.summary: Downward offset for a held shield when a blocked hit lands
queries.description: Gives the amount a shield in the off hand should be pushed downward when its holder blocks an incoming hit, for animating that impact.
notes: Needs an item that is held by an entity; otherwise it logs a content error.

queries.name: show_bottom
queries.summary: Whether the entity's bottom should be rendered
queries.description: Returns `1` if the bottom of the entity should be drawn, otherwise `0`.

queries.name: sit_amount
queries.summary: How far the entity has moved into its sitting pose
queries.description: Gives the entity's current sit amount, smoothed between frames, which grows as it settles into a sitting pose.
notes: Only meaningful for rendering; server-side evaluation returns a default value.

queries.name: skin_id
queries.summary: The entity's skin ID
queries.description: Returns the entity's skin ID, a number set by the `minecraft:skin_id` component. Returns `0` if none is set.

queries.name: sleep_rotation
queries.summary: Rotation of the bed the player is sleeping in, in degrees
queries.description: Returns the facing of the bed the player is sleeping in, as a rotation in degrees.

queries.name: sneeze_counter
queries.summary: The entity's sneeze counter (e.g. a sneezing panda)
queries.description: Gives the entity's current sneeze counter, useful for driving a sneeze animation such as the panda's.

queries.name: spellcolor
queries.summary: Spell color of the entity as a struct with .r .g .b .a
queries.description: Gives the color of the entity's spell effect as a struct with `.r`, `.g`, `.b` and `.a` members, each `0..1`. Every member is `0` when there is no entity.
notes: Returns a struct, not a number. Read one member (e.g. `.r`) before using it in arithmetic.

queries.name: standing_scale
queries.summary: How far the entity has moved into its standing pose
queries.description: Gives how far the entity has reared up into a standing pose, smoothed between frames. `0` means it is not standing.
notes: Only meaningful for rendering; server-side evaluation returns a default value.

queries.name: state_time
queries.summary: Seconds spent in the current animation controller state
queries.description: Returns how long, in seconds, the animation controller has been in its current state. Use it in animation controller transitions and state animations.
notes: Only valid inside an animation controller; the entity must have an animation component.

queries.name: structural_integrity
queries.summary: The entity's structural integrity value
queries.description: Returns the entity's structural integrity value. Returns `0` for entities that don't track it.

queries.name: surface_particle_color
queries.summary: Particle color of the surface block under the entity (.r .g .b .a)
queries.description: Returns the particle color of the first surface block found below the entity, as a struct with `.r`, `.g`, `.b` and `.a` members in `0..1`. All members are `0` when there is no entity or no surface is found.
notes: Client only: use it in resource pack files.
Returns a struct, not a number. Read one member before using it in arithmetic.
Its behaviour differs between files with a format version older than 1.20.70 and files at 1.20.70 or newer.

queries.name: surface_particle_texture_coordinate
queries.summary: Particle UV of the surface block under the entity (.u .v)
queries.description: Returns the texture coordinate for particles of the first surface block found below the entity, as a struct with `.u` and `.v` members. Both are `0` when there is no entity or no surface is found.
notes: Client only: use it in resource pack files.
Returns a struct, not a number. Read one member before using it in arithmetic.
Its behaviour differs between files with a format version older than 1.20.70 and files at 1.20.70 or newer.

queries.name: surface_particle_texture_size
queries.summary: Particle texture size of the surface block under the entity
queries.description: Gives the texture size used for particles of the first surface block found below the entity, as a struct. Every member is `0` when there is no entity or no surface is found. The member names are not documented.
notes: Client only: use it in resource pack files.
Returns a struct, not a number. Read one member before using it in arithmetic.
Its behaviour differs between files with a format version older than 1.20.70 and files at 1.20.70 or newer.

queries.name: swell_amount
queries.summary: How swollen the creeper or wither is
queries.description: Returns how swollen the entity is, rising as a creeper gets close to exploding. Only creepers and withers report a value.
notes: Only works for `minecraft:creeper` and `minecraft:wither`.

queries.name: swelling_dir
queries.summary: Direction the entity's swelling is moving in
queries.description: Gives the direction of the entity's swelling, e.g. whether a creeper is currently puffing up or settling back down. Returns `0` for entities that don't swell.

queries.name: swim_amount
queries.summary: How far the entity is into its swimming pose
queries.description: Returns how much the entity is in its swimming pose, used to blend a swim animation in and out.

queries.name: tail_angle
queries.summary: Angle of the entity's tail (e.g. a wolf's)
queries.description: Returns the angle of the entity's tail, for example a wolf's tail rising with health. Returns `0` for entities without one.

queries.name: target_x_rotation
queries.summary: Pitch needed to aim at the entity's current target, in degrees
queries.description: Returns the x (pitch) rotation, in degrees, the entity would need to look at its current target. Returns `0` when it has no target.
notes: Client only: use it in resource pack files.

queries.name: target_y_rotation
queries.summary: Yaw needed to aim at the entity's current target, in degrees
queries.description: Returns the y (yaw) rotation, in degrees, the entity would need to look at its current target. Returns `0` when it has no target.
notes: Client only: use it in resource pack files.

queries.name: texture_frame_index
queries.summary: Icon index of an experience orb
queries.description: Gives which icon frame an experience orb should display. Other entities return `0`.

queries.name: ticks_since_last_kinetic_weapon_hit
queries.summary: Ticks since the entity last hit something with a kinetic weapon
queries.description: Gives how many ticks have passed since the entity last hit something while using a kinetic weapon. Returns `-1` when there is no such hit to report.
notes: Check for `-1` before treating the result as a tick count.

queries.name: time_of_day
queries.summary: Time of day in the entity's dimension, 0..1
queries.description: Returns the time of day in the dimension the entity is in, as a fraction of a full day: `0` is midnight, `0.25` sunrise, `0.5` noon and `0.75` sunset.

queries.name: time_since_last_vibration_detection
queries.summary: Seconds since the entity last detected a vibration
queries.description: Returns the time in seconds since the entity (e.g. a warden) last detected a vibration. Returns `-1` if it has never detected one or the value is unavailable.
notes: Client only: use it in resource pack files.

queries.name: time_stamp
queries.summary: Current time stamp of the level
queries.description: Gives the level's current time stamp, which increases as the level runs.

queries.name: timer_flag_1
queries.summary: Whether behavior.timer_flag_1 is running
queries.description: Returns `1` while the entity's `minecraft:behavior.timer_flag_1` goal is running, otherwise `0`.

queries.name: timer_flag_2
queries.summary: Whether behavior.timer_flag_2 is running
queries.description: Returns `1` while the entity's `minecraft:behavior.timer_flag_2` goal is running, otherwise `0`.

queries.name: timer_flag_3
queries.summary: Whether behavior.timer_flag_3 is running
queries.description: Returns `1` while the entity's `minecraft:behavior.timer_flag_3` goal is running, otherwise `0`.

queries.name: total_emitter_count
queries.summary: Number of active particle emitters in the world
queries.description: Returns how many particle emitters are currently active in the world.
notes: Client only: use it in resource pack files.

queries.name: total_particle_count
queries.summary: Number of active particles in the world
queries.description: Returns how many particles are currently alive in the world. Useful for scaling down effects when many particles are already on screen.
notes: Client only: use it in resource pack files.

queries.name: touch_only_affects_hotbar
queries.summary: Whether touch input is set to only affect the hotbar
queries.description: Returns `1` if the player's touch controls are set so touch input only affects the hotbar, otherwise `0`.
notes: Client only: use it in resource pack files.

queries.name: trade_tier
queries.summary: The entity's trading tier (villager level)
queries.description: Returns the entity's current trade tier, which for villagers follows their profession level. Returns `0` for entities that don't trade.

queries.name: unhappy_counter
queries.summary: Unused; always returns 0
queries.description: Always returns `0`. It was meant to report panda unhappiness but never did.
notes: Has no effect: the result is always 0. Don't build logic on it.

queries.name: variant
queries.summary: The entity's variant index
queries.description: Returns the entity's variant number, as set by the `minecraft:variant` component. Returns `0` if the entity has no variant.
notes: Pairs with `minecraft:variant` in the behavior pack; use `query.mark_variant` for `minecraft:mark_variant`.

queries.name: vertical_speed
queries.summary: Vertical speed of the entity in blocks per second
queries.description: Returns how fast the entity is moving up or down, in blocks (meters) per second. Positive values mean it is going up.

queries.name: walk_distance
queries.summary: Total distance the entity has walked, in blocks
queries.description: Returns the total distance, in blocks, the entity has moved while on the ground and not sneaking. Commonly used to drive walk-cycle animations.

queries.name: wing_flap_position
queries.summary: Current wing flap position (chicken, parrot)
queries.description: Returns the current position in the entity's wing flap cycle, as used by chickens and parrots. Returns `0` for entities without flapping wings.

queries.name: wing_flap_speed
queries.summary: Current wing flap speed (chicken, parrot)
queries.description: Returns how fast the entity's wings are flapping, as used by chickens and parrots. Returns `0` for entities without flapping wings.

queries.name: yaw_speed
queries.summary: How fast the entity is turning (yaw speed)
queries.description: Returns the rate at which the entity's yaw is changing, i.e. how quickly it is turning left or right.
